title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 124 selected (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translation by Wikisource contributors. Pinned revisions and contributor histories appear in source-manifest.json. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Grouped existing source paragraphs and glosses by their printed section numbers; removed navigation and separately repeated Hebrew. No new translation or OCR. Adapted material is offered under CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Yoreh Deah 124, selected sections. Sections 6, 8, 10, 13, 16, 25 and 27 are withheld because of substantive translation errors. Source sections 23–24 are joined as base section 23; remaining text is not independently proofread and may contain other errors. Source notes outside the imported text are not included.
